narrative: On the board. The same leaf, lower. Two brackets in the margin, one against a lord and one against a man in the press. The ink of the brackets is this morning's. On the board. The second bracket. No new lines in the scene. The old lines stand, and the margin names them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Bracketed the lord and the man in the press.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Resistance, and habit
